sheet.title: Thicknesses · {{order}}

catalogue.noGroupsHint: Create the first one with the form on the left.
catalogue.newGroupHint: A group is what is inspected together: a dryer section, a press section.

catalogue.noRollers: This group has no rollers yet: add them below.

explain.title: What is recorded here?
explain.what: Ultrasonic (UT) inspection of rollers: the wall thickness of each roller is measured to know how much material is left.
explain.thickness: Thickness: six readings per roller (P1–P6). The thinnest sets its state from the UT norma: Acceptable, Medium or Critical; Inaccessible when it could not be reached.
explain.journals: Journals (presses): per press side, the roll, its diameter, outer and total length and its state.
explain.results: Results summary: the order's table, value by value, with the count per state.
explain.report: Group report: conclusions, recommendations, the group's drawing and the photo record.
explain.example: Example — Order END-UT-012 · Dryers group 1 · Roller 7: P1 9.10 · P2 8.95 · P3 8.40 · P4 8.62 · P5 7.85 · P6 8.90 mm → minimum 7.85 mm → Medium (between 6.14 and 8.01).
explain.steps: Step by step: 1) in “Groups and rollers” create the group and its rollers (once); 2) in Services create the order with the technique “NDT · UT on rollers”; 3) here, in “Fill an order”, pick order and group and fill the tabs.
